FAQ

Common questions.

Quick answers about Mowatek and how to work with us. Can’t find what you need? Send us an enquiry.

Ask a question
What does Mowatek do?

Mowatek Nigeria Limited provides engineering and technical services across five areas: water treatment, wastewater/effluent treatment, procurement and maintenance, consulting, and training.

How long has Mowatek been operating?

Mowatek was incorporated in Nigeria in 1983 as a limited liability company, with a mandate spanning mechanical, electrical, civil and marine works. Over the years it has focused strongly on water and wastewater treatment.

How do I request a quote?

Use the enquiry form and choose the service you are interested in. Tell us about your site and what you need, and the team will follow up to discuss your requirements.

What should I include in an enquiry?

The more context the better: your location, the type of water or effluent involved, approximate volumes, any existing equipment, your timeline and any quality or regulatory targets you need to meet.

Do you supply equipment only, or also install and maintain it?

Procurement and maintenance is one of our five service areas, including installation and commissioning support. The scope is agreed per project, so you can ask for a single element or a complete installation.

Can you advise before we commit to a solution?

Yes. Our consulting service covers areas such as feasibility studies, design review and process optimisation, so that you can make decisions with clearer technical information.

Do you work with other companies?

We work with technical partners where appropriate, to help clients find a fit-for-purpose way forward.

Can you train our operating team?

Training and technical support is one of our services. Content and format are discussed through an enquiry so that they suit your equipment and site.

Have a project in mind?

Let’s talk about the challenge you’re trying to solve.

Tell us about your water and wastewater treatment requirements and the team will follow up.
